name: Eterbase
rootCause: European encrypted exchange ETERBASE has been hacked, resulting in the theft of some hot wallets and the loss of more than $5.4 million in assets.

descriptions.text: European encrypted exchange ETERBASE has been hacked, resulting in the theft of some hot wallets and the loss of more than $5.4 million in assets.

On September 8, 2020, Eterbase's hot wallets were compromised, resulting in the theft of over $5.3 million across six major chains. The breach led to immediate suspension of exchange operations and a prolonged operational disruption. Attackers gained access to the private keys of Eterbase's hot wallets, enabling unauthorized withdrawal of assets across Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Tezos, Algorand and TRON. The lack of robust multi-signature or cold-storage controls allowed a single compromise to drain all hot wallet funds.
